# Desmopressin

Desmopressin is a medicine. It is a man-made copy of a natural hormone in your body.

This medicine helps your body hold onto water. It can help if you wet the bed at night. It can also help if you have diabetes insipidus. This is a condition where your body loses too much water.

Your doctor will tell you how much to take. Your doctor will tell you when to take it.

Do not take more than your doctor tells you to take.

Tell your doctor if this medicine does not work for you. Tell your doctor if you have side effects.

source: With diaphragmatic involvement, splinting of the chest and pain in one or both shoulders may occur. Other manifestations of FMF include acute pleurisy (in 30 %); arthritis (in 25 %), usually involving the knee, ankle, and hip; an erysipelas - like rash of the lower leg; and scrotal swelling and pain caused by inflammation of the tunica vaginalis of the testis. output: When the diaphragm is involved, you may splint your chest and have pain in one or both shoulders. Other signs of FMF include acute pleurisy (in 30 %); arthritis (in 25 %), usually in the knee, ankle, and hip; a rash on the lower leg that looks like erysipelas; and swelling and pain in the scrotum caused by inflammation of the tunica vaginalis of the testis. Pericarditis happens very rarely.
reference: Chest pain: About 30 % of affected people have chest pain. Chest pain, which is typically triggered by breathing, is caused by inflammation of the membranes surrounding the lungs (pleuritis) or, rarely, by inflammation of the sac surrounding the heart (pericarditis). Arthritis: About 25 % of people have inflammation of large joints (arthritis), such as the knees, ankles, and hips. Rash: A painful red rash that usually appears near the ankles may occur but is comparatively rare among affected people in the United States. Scrotum pain: In males, the thick-skinned sac that surrounds and protects the testes (scrotum) may swell and be painful due to inflammation of a testis (testicle).
